newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Nine groups bid to advise on Brazil Eletrobras.
newsitem.headline: Nine groups bid to advise on Brazil Eletrobras.

text.p: Nine consortia have put in bids with Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) for mandates to advise on the sale of Furnas and Eletrosul, a BNDES spokesman said.
Furnas and Eletrosul, two of the four power generating units controled by holding company Eletrobras, are expected to be privatized late this year or early in 1998.
The spokesman could not say when the bank hopes to announce the winning bidders, but local newspapers speculated the winners would be announced by the end of next month.
The consulting firms are competing to advise the BNDES on two services.
The following two consortia are in the running for the "A" service contract, which consists of a financial evaluation of the two companies:
* Arthur D. Little/BFB Engenharia/Enerconsult Engenharia/Banco Liberal consortium led by Arthur D. Little.
* Deutsche Bank/Morgan Grenfell/Fator Projetos/Themag Engenharia consortium led by Deutsche Bank AG.
The following seven consortia are bidding for the "B" service contract, which includes a financial evaluation and designing a privatization model for the firms:
* Deutsche Bank/Morgan Grenfell/CS Holding's CSHZn.S Credit Suisse/Banco Fator/Fator Projetos/Fator SA Corretora/Themag Engenharia/Ernst & Young Consultores consortium led by Deutsche Bank.
* Banco Graphus/Kleinwort Benson Limited/Kleinwort Benson do Brasil/Robert Fleming/Jaakko Poyry/Stone & Webster Inc/Copem Engenharia consortium led by Banco Graphus.
* Patrimonio Planejamento Financeiro/Salomon Inc /Banco Patrimonio/Deloite/Banco Primus/Duarte Garcia/Engevix consortium led by Patrimonio Planejamento Financeiro.
* J.P. Morgan and Co Inc /Goldman, Sachs and Co/Garantia/Capital Tec/BVI Technoplan consortium led by JP Morgan.
* Maxima/SBC Warburg/Morgan Stanley Group Inc /Banco Omega/BC Projetos/RW Beck consortium led by Maxima.
* Banco Bozano Simonsen/Barclays Plc /Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc /Wald & Associados/Engecorps/Estudio Q consortium led by Bozano Simonsen.
* Coopers & Lybrand Consultores/NM Rothschild/Merrill Lynch and Co Inc / Itau Bankers Trust/Coopers Lybrand UK/Projeta Consultoria/Leme Engenharia consortium led by Coopers & Lybrand Consultores.

Furnas operates in Brazil's major southeastern states of Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais and accounts for 15 percent of the country's power generating capacity and 29 percent of Eletrobras' capacity. It has a power capacity of 8,123 megawatts.
Eletrosul has a power generating capacity of 3,222 megawatts and operates in the southern states of Parana, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul and the center-south state of Mato Grosso do Sul.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
